product.name: KYRRE stool
product.note: Parts only: screws and fittings aren’t shown, and sizes are approximate. Each step names the page of your paper manual to follow.

steps.title: Start with a board, a panel and 2 pieces
steps.instruction: Join a board, a panel and 2 pieces (A, B, C, D), as the animation shows. Page 4 of the IKEA manual shows this step.
checklist: A board, a panel and 2 pieces are joined

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the KYRRE stool. Page 4 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
The blue parts: A (board, about 35 cm), B (panel, about 43 cm), C (piece, about 43 cm), D (piece, about 43 cm). Watch where they go in the animation.
Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 45 cm tall.
